title: IT 140 Course Automation Manifest
description: Structural contract for the controlled IT 140 automation manifest. The manifest selects concrete approved products, versions, sources, platforms, deployment profiles, provider profiles, managed settings, and managed assets. Operating-system support packages are intentionally separated from course IDE capability bindings.
$comment: Validation is layered. This schema performs structural validation. The scripts must also perform semantic validation: reject duplicate JSON keys; confirm every referenced product, source, provider profile, deployment profile, settings profile, and adapter exists; confirm every required capability has one valid binding on every enabled platform; confirm deployment-profile platform, release, and architecture references are valid; confirm exactly one enabled reference deployment profile and that its platform is marked as the reference platform; confirm adapter IDs are compiled into or distributed with the approved automation release; confirm managed and obsolete paths remain within approved boundaries; confirm the manifest contains no secrets or personal values; and confirm integrity metadata is appropriate for each source type.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema compatibility version understood by this schema.

automation_release_date.description: Date on which the automation release version was assigned.

adapterId.description: Identifier for reviewed executable behavior distributed with the package. Manifest data may select but not define adapters.

automationRelease.description: Semantic version in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format without leading zeroes.

pathTemplate.description: Portable path template using only approved runtime variables such as ${HOME}, ${DESKTOP}, ${COURSE_ROOT}, ${SCRIPT_ROOT}, ${LOG_DIR}, or ${TEMP}. Semantic validation must expand and canonicalize the path before use.

osPackage.description: Platform support package that is not itself a course IDE capability. Course IDE products must be represented under course_ide_bindings.

courseIdeBindings.description: Concrete product bindings for course capabilities. These entries are separate from os_packages so platform prerequisites cannot be confused with the official course IDE.

reference_platform.description: True for the platform implementation that contains the approved reference deployment profile. Semantic validation requires exactly one enabled reference platform.

os_packages.description: Operating-system-specific prerequisites and support utilities. Do not list official course IDE products here.

reference_profile.description: True only for the approved environment used for primary development, documentation, support reproduction, and acceptance testing.

platform_id.description: Identifier of the platform implementation used by this deployment.

deploymentProfile.description: A concrete environment in which a platform implementation is deployed. Deployment profiles keep provider, desktop-environment, session, reset, release, and architecture details separate from software and package bindings.

deploymentProfileCatalog.description: Optional catalog of local, virtual, hosted, or other deployment environments. When present, semantic validation requires exactly one enabled reference profile.

values.description: Concrete product-specific settings. Keys and values are validated by the selected settings adapter.
